a.lede: A Meta spokesperson insisted that the updated terms did not reflect a change in the way Meta crawls the web.
a.title: Meta removes language that raised scraping and AI training concerns

b.lede: After backlash, Meta is updating its terms again to remove language that suggested it could scrape content from sites, including news sites, to train its AI. Specifically, the following language no longer appears on the commercial terms page: … Meta may use any content from such domains, web pages, or URLs to provide, develop, improve, […]
b.title: Meta removes language that may have allowed it to scrape news sites
